fact: On 17 November 2025 PM Abiy said the Ethiopian AI Institute has released multiple products, including text-to-speech, speech-to-text and cross-language conversion tools for Amharic, Afan Oromo, Somali, Tigrinya and Afar built on thousands of hours of audio data, and progress in cloud computing.
title: Ethiopian AI Institute Becoming Africa's Most Visible, Influential Institute, PM Abiy Says
